theory.title: Habla de tu familia y tus amigos
theory.explanation: Presenta a las personas cercanas con palabras de parentesco y amistad. Reutiliza have got para hablar de posesión: I have got y she has got. Usa my, his y her para indicar relaciones y posesión. Describe a las personas con be + adjetivo y une o contrasta ideas con and y but.
theory.tip: Have got se usa con I, you, we y they; has got con he y she. His acompaña a un nombre relacionado con he, y her a uno relacionado con she.

content.passage: My name is Mia and I have got a small family. I live with my mother and father. My mother is a teacher. She is friendly and funny. My father is a cook. He is quiet but very kind. I have got one brother. His name is Leo and he is ten. My grandmother lives near our house. My best friend is Ana; she is like family.
